== definition with an unknown field

== definition under another file name
refused: Duplicate provider ID or mismatched definition filename.

== definition of a capability its driver has not
refused: Provider capability is not implemented by its driver.

== definition with a window its driver has not
refused: Provider windows do not match the native contract.

== definition with a fractional display order
refused: Invalid provider display ordering.

== definition that is not JSON
refused: codex.json is not JSON as HotPl8 writes it (line 15, column 26).

== no definitions at all
refused: Invalid provider catalog size.

== no policy
refused: No valid policy.json. Run hotpl8 setup or see docs/install.md.

== policy with an unknown field
refused: Invalid policy: unknown versioned field.

== policy with an unknown mode
refused: Invalid policy: mode must be monitor or automate.

== policy with a margin out of range
refused: Invalid policy field: margin5h

== policy with a repeated account
refused: Invalid policy field: prefer

== policy with a reserve that is not enrolled
refused: Invalid policy field: reserve

== policy version four
refused: Invalid policy: unsupported schemaVersion.

== policy version one with newer settings
refused: New operational settings require schemaVersion 2.

== policy with an unknown capacity profile
refused: Unknown capacity profile.

== policy with critical exit below entry
refused: Critical exit must exceed entry.

== policy version three with a version two field
refused: Invalid version 3 policy field.

== policy version three with an unknown provider
refused: Provider is not registered.

== policy that is an array
refused: policy.json is not JSON as HotPl8 writes it (line 1, column 1).

== policy that is not JSON
refused: policy.json is not JSON as HotPl8 writes it (line 1, column 20).

== empty policy file
refused: policy.json is not JSON as HotPl8 writes it (line 1, column 1).

== generation time that is not a time
refused: This state cannot be shown: one of its values is not one HotPl8 writes (src/contract.rs). Run hotpl8 refresh; if that changes nothing, run hotpl8 doctor.
